verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents one-click launch of prebuilt templates (docs-13). Its template catalog names PyTorch with Jupyter, TensorFlow and Stable Diffusion UIs, and notes these large images start quickly because hosts cache them (docs-30, docs-62, docs-73). Templates can also be managed from the CLI (docs-2), and docs-27 points to copyable PyTorch, vLLM and ComfyUI deployments. Missing for 10: an explicit CUDA base template and vLLM/ComfyUI shown as first-class templates rather than example deployments, plus independent hands-on corroboration of template launches.
